maintenance_goal: Refresh collection integrity evidence before it is older than six weeks.

recurrence.rationale: The collection changes monthly and its evidence should remain no more than six weeks old.

cadence.description: Run on the first business day of each month.

trigger.description: The project schedule manifest defines the first business day trigger.

scheduler.mechanism: The project schedule manifest and runner own recurring jobs.
scheduler.executor: The project maintenance runner executes the recorded read-only route.

authority.approval_system: The project change-review record accepts or rejects follow-up work.

route.when: Every scheduled run against the frozen package inventory.
The audit returns new findings or contradictory observations.
The approval owner accepts an evidence-backed change question.

stop.condition: Stop after twelve runs, collection retirement, or owner withdrawal, whichever occurs first.
stop.on_failure: Record the failed run and pause until the approval owner reviews the blocker.

rollback.configuration: No scheduler entry is created by this proposal; an authorized adapter must remove only its receipt-bound entry.
rollback.artifacts: Retain accepted evidence under the caller's policy and discard rejected draft proposals.
